verses.1: And an man from Ephraim cried out. They passed by Tsafonah. They said to him, “Open your mouth! You’ve gone ahead to fight against the children of Israel. But we were not called to go with you. Your house will be destroyed by fire.”
verses.2: And Yiftah said to them, “I and my people were enemies of yours. We had many children who were also your enemies. I will cry out to you, but you will not save me from their hands.”
verses.3: And I will see that you are not a savior. My soul will be broken in my arms. I will go ahead to the children of my people. Jehovah has given them into my hands. Why have you come to me today to fight against me?
verses.4: And Yiftah summoned all the people of Gilgal. They fought against Ephraim. The people of Gilgal defeated Ephraim. For Ephraim’s people said, “You are part of Gilgal, within Ephraim’s territory.”
verses.5: And Gilgalad crossed the Jordan River into Ephraim. When the people of Ephraim said, “Let us allow Gilgalad to pass through,” he replied, “You people of Gilgalad, you are the Ephraimites. You must allow me to pass.”
verses.6: And they said to him, “Please, rest.” But he refused to do so. So they caught him and slaughtered him at the banks of the Jordan River. At that moment, four hundred and twenty people died.
verses.7: And Jephthah ruled over Israel for six years. Then Jephthah died. He was buried in the towns of Gilead.
verses.8: And he punished Israel after him, from the house of Laban.
verses.9: And he had thirty sons and thirty daughters. The angel of the covenant brought back to him thirty daughters from the wilderness. And he judged Israel for seven years.
verses.10: And Abchan died, and he was buried in the house of Laham.
verses.11: And he punished Israel for their sins. He punished them for twelve years.
verses.12: And Elohim died, and he was buried in Ai’lon, in the land of Zebulun.
verses.13: And he punished Israel as his servant, the son of Illyel, the prophet of destruction.
verses.14: He had forty sons and thirty sons-in-law. They rode on seventy donkeys. He ruled over Israel for seven years.
verses.15: And Abdon, son of Hillel, the Perizzite, died. He was buried in Perazzan, in the land of Efrathi, on Mount Homalak.
